name: Thejus — daily study & application timetable (v2)
_doc: Times are LOCAL 24h 'HH:MM'. Blocks must tile the full 24 hours with no gap and
no overlap; the last block wraps past midnight (end < start is allowed there only).
kind: chore | focus | work | meal | rest | sleep.
'rest' and 'sleep' are QUIET kinds -- a boundary INTO them fires a silent reminder.
A boundary into any other kind fires an ALARM.
start_alarm: true  -> also sound an alarm exactly AT the block start (wake-up only),
and suppress that block's 5-minute lead reminder.
lead_sound: true/false explicitly overrides the kind-derived sound decision.
auto_start: target string (e.g. 'goethe_b2') -> daemon self-starts the app when the block arrives.
